brief.name: Gamer Guardian
brief.pitch: Gamer monitor accessory that keeps you in peak performance with helpful reminders.
brief.what: A gamer accessory that sits on the top of your monitor and detects your presence while helping you develop habits that improve your performance.
brief.does: After detecting your presence with basic sensors (preserving privacy, no cameras, only on-device AI) this friendly, robot themed monitor accessory will remind you to take breaks, hydrate, snack, adjust posture -- things a mindful parent might remind you to do.  Those reminders take the form of a gentle fan breeze, vocal reminders using an onboard speaker,
brief.who: for young teenage gamers, but marketed really to their concerned parents who want a tool that nags their kid who is no longer responsive to their pleas.
brief.electronics: small PC fan/blower, microphone, speaker, esp32 module, gets power over USB, PIR sensor, LED that only activates to get attention.
brief.design: A chibi robot character that appeals to young teenage gamers. Need not be high-end or luxurious. Fits the existing design language of gamer brands like alienware, razer, etc.
brief.looksLike: Around the same size as other monitor mounted accessories, like Logitech webcams, small streamer LED lights.
brief.size: 2-3 inches tall and wide, 2 inches deep
